Chapter 855: Chapter 4: Lin Yuan In The River Of Time (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 855: Chapter 4: Lin Yuan in the River of Time (Please Subscribe)

“The key trump card?” Nalan, the Vice Tower Master’s eyes shone with excitement, immediately piqued with interest.

He too would enter the super-large battlefield, and naturally, he was very curious about the methods on the side of human civilization.

Xuanyuan Dua, backed by a Xuanyuan Supreme, might just be privy to many top-secret pieces of information.

“Key trump card?” Lin Yuan’s heart stirred as well.

He had discussed many matters concerning the super-large battlefield with Xia Qin, a powerhouse of human civilization. Indeed, some trump cards were prepared, but something that could be called “key”? There wasn’t any, right?

“Was it told to you by a Xuanyuan Supreme?”

Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, looked at Xuanyuan Dua with anticipation.

“No.”

Xuanyuan Dua shook her head, “It’s my own guess.”

“Hmm…” Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, was momentarily stunned and took a while to respond.

Her own guess?

“Nalan, you’ve also experienced the Two-dimensional World, you must remember that Lord?” Xuanyuan Dua turn to look at Nalan, the Vice Tower Master.

“That Lord… That Lord…” Nalan, the Vice Tower Master’s face slightly changed, “Are you referring to ‘Lord Xueyu’?”

Any human Evolutionary who fell into the Two-dimensional World would not easily forget the emergence of ‘Lord Xueyu’.

In fact, not only human Evolutionaries, but many powerhouses from the Starry Sky Races are deeply imprinted with the human ‘Xueyu’.

Since the first opening of the celestial gate in the Two-dimensional World, it marked the era of the human ‘Xueyu’. Even the most legendary lives at Level Eleven Perfect, including the Four Divine Kings who wielded their own ultimate weapons, were oppressed and crushed by ‘Xueyu’.

After the end of the Two-dimensional World, the ‘White Paper’ escaped into the universe, and not just the human civilization, but also races across the starry sky, were all inquiring about Lord Xueyu’s whereabouts and information.

Unfortunately, there were no clues.

But undoubtedly, ‘Xueyu’ certainly exists, and is suspected to have exited the Two-dimensional World, becoming the only survivor among the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses.

The powerhouses of the Starry Sky Races speculated that Xueyu must belong to the group of hidden Evolutionaries within human civilization; otherwise, there would not be a total lack of information.

The number of Level Eleven Evolutionaries openly known in human civilization does not exceed a thousand.

The thousand Level Eleven Evolutionaries mentioned here refers to those known publicly; in truth, human civilization is also cultivating a batch of Evolutionaries in the shadows.

This is the hidden strength of human civilization.

This kind of preparation is not just present in human civilization, but other cosmic race powers also have the same preparations.

“Are you saying that Lord Xueyu will also enter the super-large battlefield?”

Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, immediately grasped this, looking at Xuanyuan Dua with enthused eyes.

“Likely.”

“Such an event that affects the entire universe, Lord Xueyu will surely participate.”

Xuanyuan Dua said, which was also her conjecture.

In fact, Xuanyuan Dua had also asked the Xuanyuan Supreme, but she got no responses. However, she firmly believed that Lord Xueyu was definitely going to take action in the upcoming super-large battlefield.

“If Lord Xueyu takes action, then there’s nothing to worry about.”

Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, stated.

Although the super-large battlefield of different races is not the same as the Two-dimensional World, where the former allows the unrestrained use of ultimate weapons, even inviting the attention and possible interference of Level Twelve.

But given the dominance shown by Lord Xueyu in the Two-dimensional World, even placed into the super-large battlefield of different races, he would undoubtedly belong to the strongest group. At least with Lord Xueyu present, the odds of human civilization gaining the upper hand would increase.

Lin Yuan quietly listened to the exchange between Xuanyuan Dua and Nalan, the Vice Tower Master.

To a certain degree, Xuanyuan Dua wasn’t wrong; the ‘Xueyu’ from the Two-dimensional World was indeed Lin Yuan himself, and he would also participate in the imminent opening of the super-large battlefield.

…

“Galaxy Master, in the Two-dimensional World, you missed the opportunity to meet with Lord Xueyu, but during this super-large battlefield, there should still be a chance.”

Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, looked at Lin Yuan with a smile on his face.

“Having the chance to meet Lord Xueyu is not an opportunity every Level Eleven can have.”

Xuanyuan Dua also chimed in from the side.

Neither Xuanyuan Dua nor Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, had any idea that the Lord Xueyu they were talking about was right in front of them.

…

The gathering was only held for half a day.

The Level Eleven Evolutionaries briefly interacted and then dispersed one after another.

On the Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

“The Path Splitting Realm…” Thoughts about the Level Twelve Path Splitting Realm surfaced in Lin Yuan’s mind.

The essence of the Path Splitting Realm is the need to pioneer one’s own unique Dao; this is the only way to completely stabilize one’s Level Twelve realm.

“I wonder, what kind of Dao will I pioneer?”

Lin Yuan was quite curious; normally, the Dao established by Level Twelve would have been set during the successful push to the ultimate stage.

And the rest would be a matter of progressing step by step.

“Continue cultivating.”

Lin Yuan was about to commence his cultivation and Dao enlightenment.

Suddenly.

Just then.

A profound and far-reaching fluctuation of space-time arrived from the depths of distant space.

“That place is…”

Lin Yuan looked up, “The location where the super-large battlefield is being established?”

Lin Yuan quickly thought to himself.

To ensure the just opened super-large battlefield is sturdy enough to withstand unrestrained fighting from Level Eleven Perfects wielding ultimate weapons.

Several supremes joined forces to drag out dozens of large Cosmic Secret Realms from deeper layers of the void, merging them to make the foundation for the super-large battlefield.

According to Xia Qin, the supreme’s speculation, the final super-large battlefield established would be highly resilient to battle power, and could even accommodate brief exchanges of Level Twelve forces.

“Is this the work of Level Twelve?”

Lin Yuan keenly felt that this space-time fluctuation, even for those at Level Eleven Perfect of the Fifth Realm, could only grasp a vague sense.
